# FU3 answer key

`<case>.json` is the report of `gnd check models/ring.orm.yaml
populations/<case>.pop.yaml --rule-ids --format json`, and `<case>.v7.json`
the same command without `--rule-ids`, run from the corpus directory at
main `1e63aeb5`, before any FU3 change (`self-loop` at 9662812e, which
changes no source). `exits.json` gives each case's exit
code, the same on both versions.
